about:
Where each shown question's answer comes from: a verse of Scripture, or something outside the Bible (owner,
2026-10-23: "either there's a verse or there isn't").

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: No shown verse calls Genesis part of an "Old Testament." Genesis 5:1 only calls itself "the book of the generations of Adam." The Old/New Testament division is a later arrangement of the Bible as a book.

before.question: In which part of the Bible is the book of Genesis found?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: No shown verse names the Old or New Testament; 2 Samuel 1:1 only narrates David after Saul's death. The division is a fact about the Bible's arrangement, not stated in Scripture.

before.question: In which part of the Bible is the book of 2 Samuel found?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Nahum 1:1 calls the book a "vision" of Nahum the Elkoshite, so it is prophetic. The label "Minor Prophet" comes from the book's place among the Twelve, a division of the Bible as a book, not from any verse.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Nahum?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 1 John 3:14 says, "We know that we have passed from death to life, because we love our brothers," which matches the printed answer exactly.

before.question: In 1 John 3:14, what do believers know they have passed from and to?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Corinthians 5:17 says that if anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation, and the old has passed away. The printed answer matches the verse.

before.question: According to 2 Corinthians 5:17, if anyone is in Christ, what is he?
before.answer: A new creation; the old has passed away
before.right: A new creation; the old has passed away

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Jesus says the disciples may ask whatever they want "in My name" (John 14:13) and "ask Me for anything in My name" (John 14:14), so the answer is the name of Jesus.

before.question: In John 14:13-14, in whose name does Jesus tell His disciples to ask?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Philippians 4:19 says that "my God will supply all your needs according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus," so the answer is stated directly.

before.question: According to Philippians 4:19, what will my God supply according to His glorious riches in Christ Jesus?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Hebrews 11:1 states that faith is the assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see, matching the printed answer.

before.question: According to Hebrews 11:1, what is faith described as being?
before.answer: The assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see
before.right: The assurance of what we hope for and the certainty of what we do not see

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Revelation 12:11 says the believers conquered the accuser by the blood of the Lamb and by the word of their testimony, which matches the printed answer.

before.question: According to Revelation 12:11, the believers overcame the accuser by the blood of the Lamb and by what else?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Habakkuk 1:1 calls Habakkuk a prophet and his book a burden received in a vision. The "Minor Prophet" label is the book's place in the Bible's arrangement, which the verses do not mention.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Habakkuk?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Zeph 1:1 shows the book is the word of the LORD given to Zephaniah, a prophet. "Minor" is a later label for its place among the Twelve, based on length, not on the verses.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Zephaniah?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Haggai 1:1 calls him "Haggai the prophet," but no shown verse uses the term "Minor Prophet." That label comes from the book's place and length in the prophetic division of the canon.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Haggai?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Zech 1:1 calls Zechariah "the prophet," so the verses support prophet. "Minor Prophet" is a label for the book's place in the canon and its length, which no verse states.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Zechariah?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Malachi 1:1 calls the book a burden of the LORD's word through Malachi, so it is prophetic, but no verse calls it "minor." The label comes from the book's shorter length in the Bible's order.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Malachi?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: No shown verse calls the book of Matthew a gospel. Mark 1:1 uses "gospel" only for the good news about Jesus; the label "Gospel" for Matthew is a classification of the book's genre.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Matthew?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Mark 1:1 opens the book by calling its contents "the beginning of the gospel of Jesus Christ," so the book names itself a gospel.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Mark?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Luke 1:1-4 calls this book an orderly account of the things fulfilled among us, not a gospel. The label "Gospel" is the genre classification the church gives the book, not a term Luke uses.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Luke?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: John 20:30-31 states the book's purpose, that readers may believe Jesus is the Christ, but never calls the book a "gospel." The label "Gospel" is the traditional genre name for John's book, not something the verses say.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of John?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: No shown verse names the testaments. The Old Testament/New Testament division is the Bible's arrangement as a book, and 1 Kings falls in the Old Testament.

before.question: Is the book of 1 Kings found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Calling Acts "History" is a classification of its genre as a narrative of the early church, not something a verse states. None of the shown passages are from Acts.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Acts?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Romans 1:1-7 opens as a personal letter from Paul to "all in Rome" with a greeting of grace and peace, so the answer, a letter or epistle, follows from the text. The word "epistle" itself does not appear.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Romans?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The opening names Paul as writer and addresses the church of God in Corinth with a greeting of grace and peace, which is the form of a letter, so the book is an epistle.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of 1 Corinthians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The opening names the writer (Paul), the recipients (the church in Corinth), and gives a greeting of grace and peace, which is the form of a letter.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of 2 Corinthians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The opening verses have the form of a letter: Paul names himself as writer and addresses "the churches of Galatia," so the book is an epistle.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Galatians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Ephesians 1:1-2 opens with a sender (Paul), a recipient (the saints in Ephesus), and a greeting of grace and peace, the form of a letter, so the book is an epistle.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Ephesians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Philippians opens as a letter: Paul and Timothy write "to all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi" with a greeting of grace and peace, so the book is an epistle.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Philippians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Colossians 4:16 calls the book "this letter" that is to be read in the churches, and Colossians 1:1-2 opens it as a letter from Paul, so the answer "Epistle" is stated in the text.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Colossians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The opening verse has the form of a letter: Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy write to the church of the Thessalonians with a greeting of grace and peace, so the book is an epistle.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of 1 Thessalonians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The book opens as a letter from Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy to the Thessalonian church, and 3:17 describes Paul's handwritten greeting as his mark "in every letter," so it is a letter.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of 2 Thessalonians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: No shown verse names the testaments. The answer comes from the Bible's arrangement as a book: 2 Kings falls in the Old Testament, before the Gospels.

before.question: Is the book of 2 Kings found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The opening verses have the form of a letter: Paul names himself as sender and Timothy as recipient, then gives a greeting. That makes it an epistle, a letter.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of 1 Timothy?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The opening names the sender (Paul), the recipient (Timothy), and gives a greeting of grace, mercy, and peace, so the book is written in letter form, an epistle.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of 2 Timothy?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Titus opens as a letter: Paul names himself as the writer and addresses "Titus, my true child," so the book is a letter, an epistle.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Titus?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The opening names Paul as writer and Philemon as recipient, then gives a greeting, so the book is written as a personal letter, which is what "epistle" means.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Philemon?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The author says he has "written to you briefly" and closes with greetings and a blessing, the form of a letter. Hebrews calls itself a "word of exhortation," so the label "epistle" is a reading of its form.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Hebrews?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: James 1:1 opens with a letter's form: the writer named, the recipients ("To the twelve tribes"), and a greeting. That letter form marks the book as an epistle.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of James?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 1 Peter 1:1 opens with a letter's form: Peter as sender, "To the elect" as recipients, so the book reads as an epistle. The verse never uses the word "epistle" itself.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of 1 Peter?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Peter calls 2 Peter his "second letter" to his readers, so the book identifies itself as an epistle, a letter.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of 2 Peter?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: No verse calls 1 John an epistle; that is a genre label from literary study. Verses like 1 John 5:13 ("I have written these things to you") show it is written to readers, but not that it is an epistle.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of 1 John?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The book is written as a letter: it opens with the writer and addressee, says he would rather write face to face than with paper and ink, and closes with greetings from another church.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of 2 John?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: No shown verse names the Testament or division of the Bible where 1 Chronicles sits. The shown verses mention other "Chronicles" books of Israel's and Judah's kings, which are not about the Bible's order.

before.question: In which part of the Bible is the book of 1 Chronicles found?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 3 John 1:1 opens like a letter, naming the writer ("The elder") and the recipient ("To the beloved Gaius"), so the book is an epistle, a letter, though the verse never uses that word.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of 3 John?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Jude 1:1-3 opens like a letter: a named writer, addressed recipients, a greeting, and Jude saying he writes to urge them. The word "epistle" itself does not appear.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Jude?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Revelation calls itself "the revelation of Jesus Christ" (1:1) and "the words of this prophecy" (1:3), so the book describes itself as both revelation and prophecy.

before.question: Which of these best describes the book of Revelation?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: No shown verse names the author of Genesis. Deuteronomy 31:9 says Moses wrote "this law," which is Deuteronomy's law. The Mosaic attribution of Genesis is traditional, not stated in these verses.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Genesis?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Exodus does not name its author. Exodus 24:4 says Moses wrote down the LORD's words, which tradition extends to the whole book; the attribution itself comes from tradition.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Exodus?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Leviticus 1:1 says the LORD called to Moses and spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, so the answer is Moses.

before.question: In Leviticus 1:1, whom did the LORD call and speak to from the Tent of Meeting?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Numbers 33:2 says Moses recorded the stages of Israel's journey at the LORD's command, but the book never names its author. Mosaic authorship is a traditional attribution, not a statement in the text.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Numbers?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Deuteronomy 31:9 says Moses wrote down this law and gave it to the priests and elders. The verse does not name the book, so the traditional attribution of the whole book to Moses is taught rather than stated.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Deuteronomy?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Joshua 24:26 says only that Joshua recorded the covenant words at Shechem in the Book of the Law of God. No verse names the author of the book of Joshua; the traditional attribution comes from outside Scripture.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Joshua?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: No shown verse says which testament 2 Chronicles belongs to. That placement comes from the Bible's arrangement as a book, where Chronicles follows Kings in the Old Testament.

before.question: Is the book of 2 Chronicles found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: No shown verse names who wrote 1 Samuel. 1 Samuel 10:25 says Samuel wrote the rights of kingship on a scroll, not the book itself. The attribution to Samuel is tradition.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of 1 Samuel?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 1 Chronicles 29:29 names the Chronicles of Samuel the Seer, the Chronicles of Nathan the Prophet, and the Chronicles of Gad the Seer as the records of David's acts.

before.question: According to 1 Chronicles 29:29, along with Samuel the seer, which two men wrote records of the acts of King David?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: After Elijah is taken up, Elisha picks up the cloak that fell from him, and the sons of the prophets say the spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha.

before.question: In 2 Kings 2, who takes up Elijah's cloak and carries on his work as prophet after Elijah is taken up to heaven?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: No shown verse names the author of 1 Chronicles. The attribution to Ezra is Jewish tradition (the Talmud, Bava Batra 15a), not something the text states.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of 1 Chronicles?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: In 2 Chronicles 36:23, Cyrus king of Persia proclaims that the LORD has appointed him to build a house for Him at Jerusalem in Judah.

before.question: At the end of 2 Chronicles, which king of Persia proclaimed that the LORD had appointed him to build a house for Him in Jerusalem?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Ezra 7:1-6 and 7:11 identify Ezra as a priest, scribe, and descendant of Aaron, but no shown verse says he wrote the book. The authorship tradition comes from outside Scripture.

before.question: Which priest and scribe, a descendant of Aaron, is traditionally credited with writing the book that bears his name?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Nehemiah 1:1 opens the book with "These are the words of Nehemiah son of Hacaliah," so the book itself names Nehemiah as the source of its words.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Nehemiah?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Esther 9:20 says outright that "Mordecai recorded these events and sent letters to all the Jews in all the provinces of King Xerxes," so the answer is Mordecai.

before.question: According to Esther 9:20, who recorded the events of Purim and sent letters to all the Jews in the provinces of King Ahasuerus?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Ezra 1:1 shows the book begins with Cyrus's decree, but no verse names the Testament or division Ezra belongs to; that comes from the Bible's arrangement as a book.

before.question: In which part of the Bible is the book of Ezra found?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Proverbs 1:1 opens the book by calling it "the proverbs of Solomon son of David, king of Israel," which names Solomon as the one credited with it.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Proverbs?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Eccl 1:1 names the author only as "the Teacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem," and the book never states the name Solomon. The attribution to Solomon is the traditional identification of that description.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Ecclesiastes?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Isaiah 1:1 names the prophet as "Isaiah son of Amoz," so the answer Amoz is stated directly in the verse.

before.question: According to Isaiah 1:1, the prophet Isaiah was the son of whom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Jeremiah 36:4 says Jeremiah called Baruch son of Neriah, who wrote on a scroll at Jeremiah's dictation all the words the LORD had spoken to him.

before.question: In Jeremiah 36:4, who wrote on a scroll at Jeremiah's dictation all the words the LORD had spoken to him?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Scripture does not name the author of Lamentations. Second Chronicles 35:25 says Jeremiah lamented Josiah and that laments were written in a "Book of Laments," which the tradition of Jeremiah's authorship draws on.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Lamentations?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Ezekiel 1:3 says the word of the LORD came to Ezekiel the priest, son of Buzi, in the land of the Chaldeans by the River Kebar, so the answer is Ezekiel.

before.question: Which priest, the son of Buzi, received the word of the LORD by the Kebar River in the land of the Chaldeans?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Daniel 7:1 says that in Belshazzar's first year Daniel had a dream and wrote it down, and Daniel 7:3 introduces the four great beasts from the sea.

before.question: Who had a dream of four beasts in the first year of Belshazzar king of Babylon, and wrote down the substance of it?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Neh 1:1 only names the author and setting of the book. Nothing shown says whether it is Old or New Testament; that placement is a fact about the Bible's order, not its text.

before.question: Is the book of Nehemiah found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Hosea 1:1 says the word of the LORD came to Hosea son of Beeri in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

before.question: Which prophet, the son of Beeri, received the word of the LORD during the reigns of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Joel 1:1 states the word of the LORD came to "Joel son of Pethuel," so the answer Pethuel is given directly in the verse.

before.question: According to Joel 1:1, who was the father of the prophet Joel?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Amos 1:1 says Amos "was among the sheepherders of Tekoa," before he prophesied, which matches the printed answer.

before.question: According to Amos 1:1, what was Amos's work before he prophesied?
before.answer: He was one of the sheepherders of Tekoa.
before.right: He was one of the sheepherders of Tekoa.

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Obadiah 1:1 says the vision of Obadiah is "what the Lord GOD says about Edom," so the answer is stated directly in the reference verse.

before.question: Against which nation does the vision of Obadiah speak?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Jonah 1:1 names the prophet as "Jonah son of Amittai," so the answer Amittai is stated in the verse.

before.question: According to Jonah 1:1, whose son was the prophet Jonah?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Micah 1:1 calls him "Micah the Moreshite," the gentilic form of Moresheth, so the verse identifies his hometown as Moresheth without naming it outright.

before.question: According to Micah 1:1, the word of the LORD came to Micah of which town?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Nahum 1:1 states that the burden (oracle) of the book is against Nineveh, so the answer is Nineveh.

before.question: According to Nahum 1:1, the oracle of Nahum is concerning which city?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Habakkuk 1:1 says the burden was received by "Habakkuk the prophet," so the answer is stated directly in the question's own reference.

before.question: According to Habakkuk 1:1, what was Habakkuk's role, as the one who received the burden?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The book's opening superscription says this word of the LORD came to Zephaniah son of Cushi, naming the prophet as the source of the book's message.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Zephaniah?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Haggai 1:1 says the word of the LORD came through Haggai the prophet to Zerubbabel and Joshua the high priest in the second year of Darius.

before.question: In the second year of King Darius, through which prophet did the word of the LORD come to Zerubbabel the governor and Joshua the high priest?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Esther 1:1 shows the book opening in the days of Xerxes, but no verse names the Old or New Testament. The division into testaments is a fact about how the Bible is arranged.

before.question: In which part of the Bible is the book of Esther found?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Zechariah 1:1 names the prophet as "Zechariah son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo," so the answer Berechiah is stated directly.

before.question: According to Zechariah 1:1, whose son was the prophet Zechariah?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Acts 12:12 says Mary's son John was "also called Mark," so the answer is stated directly in the question's own reference.

before.question: In Acts 12:12, Peter went to the house of Mary, the mother of John. By what other name was this John known?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: John 21:24 says only that an unnamed disciple wrote these things; it never gives his name. The name John comes from the church's historical tradition of authorship.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the Gospel that tells how Jesus raised Lazarus from the dead?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Acts 1:1 has the writer mention his "first book" to Theophilus, but no verse names him. Luke appears in Colossians 4:14 and Philemon 1:24 as Paul's companion, not as author. The attribution comes from early church tradition.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Acts?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The letter opens by naming its writer: "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God, and Timothy our brother," so the answer Paul is given in 2 Cor 1:1.

before.question: Who wrote the book of 2 Corinthians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The shown verses tell Job's story but never mention the Old or New Testament. Job's placement in the Old Testament is a fact about the Bible's order and divisions, not something these verses state.

before.question: Is the book of Job found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Galatians 1:1 opens with "Paul, an apostle," naming Paul as the writer, so the answer comes from the letter's own opening verse.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Galatians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Ephesians 1:1 opens with "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God," so the verse itself names Paul as the writer.

before.question: Who names himself as the writer in the opening verse of the letter to the Ephesians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The letter opens by naming its writers: "Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi." Paul is the named author.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Philippians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Colossians 1:1 opens with "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God," naming Paul as the writer, so the answer comes from the verse itself.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of Colossians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The letter opens by naming its senders, "Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy," and 2:18 has Paul say "I, Paul," so Paul is named as the writer.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of 1 Thessalonians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Thessalonians 1:1 names Paul as the writer, with Silvanus and Timothy, and 3:17 says the closing greeting is in Paul's own hand.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of 2 Thessalonians?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 1 Timothy 1:1 opens the letter with "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus," so the letter itself names Paul as its writer.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of 1 Timothy?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Timothy 1:1 opens with "Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God," naming Paul as the writer, which matches the printed answer.

before.question: Who is traditionally credited as the author of the book of 2 Timothy?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Titus 1:1 opens the letter with "Paul, a servant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ," naming Paul as the writer.

before.question: Who is named as the author of the letter to Titus?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The letter's opening names its writer: "Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother," and Philemon 1:19 adds, "I, Paul, write this with my own hand."

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Verse 13 says Shallum reigned in Samaria, dated against Judah's king Uzziah, and verse 15 places his acts in the Chronicles of the Kings of Israel, so the kingdom is Israel.

before.question: Shallum son of Jabesh, who struck down King Zechariah, reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 15:17 says Menahem son of Gadi became king of Israel in the thirty-ninth year of Azariah's reign over Judah and reigned in Samaria ten years.

before.question: King Menahem reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 15:23 says Pekahiah son of Menahem became king of Israel and reigned in Samaria two years, so the answer is stated directly in the verse.

before.question: King Pekahiah reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 15:27 says Pekah son of Remaliah became king of Israel and reigned in Samaria twenty years. The verse names Israel; "northern" is a common label for it.

before.question: King Pekah reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 17:1 says Hoshea son of Elah became king of Israel and reigned in Samaria nine years, set against Judah's reign of Ahaz. The answer is stated there.

before.question: King Hoshea reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 1 Kings 14:21 says Rehoboam son of Solomon reigned in Judah, and 1 Kings 12:17 says he reigned over Israelites in the cities of Judah. "Southern" is a reasonable gloss.

before.question: King Rehoboam reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Chronicles 13:1 says Abijah became king of Judah, and 13:2 says he reigned in Jerusalem. The verses do not use the word "southern."

before.question: King Abijah reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 1 Kings 15:9 says Asa became king of Judah, and 15:10 says he reigned in Jerusalem. The verses do not use the word "southern," which is a description of Judah's position.

before.question: King Asa reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 1 Kings 22:41 says Jehoshaphat son of Asa became king of Judah, and 2 Chronicles 20:31 says he reigned over Judah. "Southern" is a descriptive addition, not stated in these verses.

before.question: King Jehoshaphat reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Joel 1:1 shows Joel was a prophet who received the word of the LORD, and Acts 2:16 quotes him as Scripture, but no shown verse says where Joel sits in the canon's order.

before.question: Is the book of Joel found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Athaliah destroys the "royal heirs of the house of Judah" and "ruled the land" while Joash is hidden, so the verses teach she ruled Judah. "Southern" is the divided-kingdom label, which the verses do not state.

before.question: Queen Athaliah reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 12:18 calls him "King Joash of Judah," and 2 Kings 13:1 also refers to "Joash son of Ahaziah over Judah," so the answer is given in the text.

before.question: King Joash, the son of Ahaziah who was hidden in the temple as a child, reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 14:1 says Amaziah son of Joash became king of Judah, which answers the question. "Southern" is the usual description of Judah as the southern kingdom.

before.question: King Amaziah reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The people of Judah made Uzziah king, and he reigned in Jerusalem. The verses name Judah, not Israel, so "southern Kingdom of Judah" follows from them, with "southern" implied by the contrast with Israel in 2 Kings 15:1.

before.question: King Uzziah reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 15:32 says Jotham son of Uzziah became king of Judah. "Southern" is the usual label for Judah, the kingdom south of Israel, and the verses shown confirm that contrast.

before.question: King Jotham reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 16:1 says Ahaz son of Jotham became king of Judah. The word "southern" is not in the verse but describes Judah's position after the division of the kingdom.

before.question: King Ahaz reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The verse says Hezekiah son of Ahaz became king of Judah, set against Hoshea's reign over Israel. "Southern" is not in the text but fits the Judah–Israel contrast.

before.question: King Hezekiah reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 21:11 calls him "Manasseh king of Judah," and 21:17 cites the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah. The word "southern" is not in the text, but it is a fair description of Judah.

before.question: King Manasseh reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 21:25 names the Book of the Chronicles of the Kings of Judah, and 21:19 says Amon reigned in Jerusalem. Judah is the southern kingdom; the word "southern" is the question's added label.

before.question: King Amon reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 22:18 calls Josiah "the king of Judah," and 22:1 places his reign in Jerusalem. The verses do not use the word "southern," which is a gloss on the name.

before.question: King Josiah reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Leviticus's place in the Old Testament comes from the arrangement of the printed Bible, not from any shown verse. The shown passages only mention the Book of the Law or Moses' writings.

before.question: Is the book of Leviticus found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The shown verses (Amos 1:1 and others) present Amos as a prophet's book, but none says where it sits in the Bible; placement among the Old Testament books is a fact about the Bible's order.

before.question: Is the book of Amos found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Jeremiah 26:1 calls Jehoiakim "king of Judah." The question's own reference only says he reigned in Jerusalem, so it does not name the kingdom.

before.question: King Jehoiakim reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 24:12 calls Jehoiachin "king of Judah," and 24:8 places his reign in Jerusalem. The verses name Judah; the word "southern" is added from the later division of the kingdom.

before.question: King Jehoiachin reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Jeremiah 37:1 calls Zedekiah "the king of Judah," and the reference notes he reigned in Jerusalem and Judah. The word "southern" is not in these verses; it is a later label for the divided kingdom.

before.question: King Zedekiah reigned over which kingdom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Acts 13:22 names David as the man after God's own heart, and 1 Samuel 17:49-50 records David killing the Philistine, Goliath, with a stone and sword. 1 Samuel 13:14 itself does not name him.

before.question: Which king, whom the LORD sought as "a man after His own heart," killed the giant Goliath as a young man?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Samuel anoints Saul as ruler (10:1); Saul seeks a medium at Endor (28:7); and Samuel says the kingship is lost because Saul did not obey the LORD (28:18). "First king" is implied by the anointing rather than stated.

before.question: Who was Israel's first king, later consulted a medium at Endor, and lost the kingdom through disobedience?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 1 Kings 16:29 names Ahab son of Omri as king of Israel, 16:31 says he married Jezebel and served Baal, and 18:18 has Elijah confronting him for following the Baals.

before.question: Which king of Israel married Jezebel and was confronted by the prophet Elijah over Baal worship?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 22:1 names Josiah as the king, and 22:8 records Hilkiah finding the Book of the Law in the house of the LORD. The reform that followed is described in 2 Kings 23:4-24.

before.question: Under which king of Judah was the Book of the Law found in the temple, leading him to a great religious reform?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Chronicles 33:11-13 says the Lord let Assyrian commanders take Manasseh to Babylon, and that in distress he humbled himself, and was brought back to Jerusalem and his kingdom.

before.question: Which king of Judah was carried away captive to Babylon, humbled himself, and was later restored to his throne?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Obadiah 1:1 shows Obadiah as a prophetic vision about Edom, but no shown verse says where the book is placed in the canon; its Old Testament position comes from the Bible's arrangement.

before.question: Is the book of Obadiah found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: When Rehoboam refused the people, Israel went home and Rehoboam reigned only over Judah, while Israel made Jeroboam king. The split happens during Rehoboam's reign.

before.question: Under which king did the united kingdom of Israel split into two kingdoms?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 9:20 says the charioteer drives "like Jehu son of Nimshi... like a madman," and 10:17 says Jehu struck down everyone of Ahab's house in Samaria. The identity is drawn from these verses.

before.question: Which king of Israel drove his chariot "like a madman" and struck down the house of Ahab?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Chronicles 26:16 says King Uzziah entered the Temple to burn incense on the altar, and 26:19 says leprosy broke out on his forehead while he raged against the priests there.

before.question: Which king of Judah was struck with leprosy after unlawfully burning incense in the Temple?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Kings 25:2 says the city was besieged until King Zedekiah's eleventh year, and 25:4 says the city was breached during that siege, so Zedekiah was the reigning king when Jerusalem fell.

before.question: Who was the last king of Judah when Jerusalem fell to Babylon?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Matthew 2:16 says that Herod, enraged at the Magi, sent orders and put to death all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity two years old and under.

before.question: Which ruler ordered the massacre of infant boys in Bethlehem after Jesus was born?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Jehoshaphat appointed singers who went before the army, and when they began their praise the LORD set ambushes against the enemy, who were defeated. Judah did not fight.

before.question: Which king of Judah sent out singers ahead of his army and won a battle without fighting?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Acts 2:14 says Peter stood up with the Eleven and addressed the crowd; Acts 2:41 says about three thousand were added that day after those who embraced his message were baptized.

before.question: Which apostle preached the sermon at Pentecost after which about three thousand were added to the believers that day?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Jonah 1:1 shows a prophet receiving the LORD's word, but no shown verse names the testaments. Jonah's placement in the Old Testament comes from the Bible's arrangement of books, not from the text.

before.question: Is the book of Jonah found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: John 1:40-42 says Andrew, Simon Peter's brother, first found Simon and then brought him to Jesus. The answer is Andrew.

before.question: Which apostle was Peter's brother and first brought him to meet Jesus?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Acts 12:2 says Herod had James, the brother of John, killed with the sword. Mark 3:17 names that John's brother as James son of Zebedee, so the answer follows from the two verses together.

before.question: Which apostle, the brother of John, did King Herod put to death with the sword?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: John 1:45 says Philip found Nathanael, and John 1:46 records Philip's words, "Come and see," in answer to Nathanael's doubt about Nazareth.

before.question: Which apostle brought Nathanael to meet Jesus, saying "Come and see"?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: John 14:8 says Philip spoke these words: "Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us."

before.question: Which apostle asked Jesus, "Lord, show us the Father, and that will be enough for us"?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Matthew 10:3 reads "Philip and Bartholomew," so Bartholomew is named directly after Philip in the list of the twelve.

before.question: In Matthew 10:3, which apostle is named right after Philip in the list of the twelve?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: John 1:47 says that when Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, He called him "a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit."

before.question: Which man did Jesus describe as "a true Israelite, in whom there is no deceit"?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Micah 1:1 shows the book is a prophecy from the days of Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah. Its placement in the Old Testament is a fact about the Bible's arrangement that no verse states.

before.question: Is the book of Micah found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Matthew 10:2-3 lists James son of Zebedee and James son of Alphaeus separately, but no verse calls either "the Less." That nickname is church tradition, loosely tied to Mark 15:40's "James the younger."

before.question: Which of the Twelve, listed in Matthew 10:3, is traditionally called "James the Less" to distinguish him from James the brother of John?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Matthew 10:3 lists "James son of Alphaeus, and Thaddaeus," so Thaddaeus is the apostle named immediately after James son of Alphaeus.

before.question: In Matthew 10:2-4, which apostle is named right after James son of Alphaeus?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Luke 6:15 names "Simon called the Zealot" among the twelve. The verse does not say the title is political; that sense comes from history, not the text.

before.question: Which apostle is identified in the Gospels by the political title "the Zealot"?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: John 12:6 says Judas, as keeper of the money bag, used to take from what was put into it. John 13:29 confirms that Judas kept the money bag.

before.question: Which apostle served as treasurer for Jesus and the twelve, keeping the money bag?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Acts 1:26 says the disciples cast lots, the lot fell to Matthias, and he was added to the eleven apostles, answering the question directly.

before.question: Which man was chosen by casting lots to replace Judas Iscariot among the twelve apostles?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Acts 9:3 records the light from heaven on the road to Damascus, and Acts 13:9 says "Saul, who was also called Paul," so the answer Paul is stated.

before.question: Which apostle, formerly named Saul, was converted after seeing a bright light on the road to Damascus?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: 2 Corinthians 12:7 says that to keep Paul from becoming conceited he was given a thorn in the flesh, so the answer is Paul, who wrote the letter.

before.question: Which apostle wrote that he was given "a thorn in my flesh" to keep him from becoming conceited?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Paul is sent to Italy, where an angel tells him he must stand before Caesar. The ship then runs aground on a sandbar, though everyone reaches land safely.

before.question: Which apostle was shipwrecked on the way to stand trial in Rome, as recorded in Acts?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Nahum 1:1 identifies the book as the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite but does not name a division of the Bible. Nahum's placement in the Old Testament comes from the Bible's arrangement, not from these verses.

before.question: In which part of the Bible is the book of Nahum found?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Acts 4:36 says the apostles called Joseph "Barnabas," meaning Son of Encouragement. Acts 13:4 shows Barnabas and Saul going out on the journey to Cyprus, sent by the Holy Spirit.

before.question: Which man, whose name means "son of encouragement," traveled with Paul on his first missionary journey?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Gideon sets out the fleece test in Judges 6:36-37, and in Judges 7:7 the LORD says He will save Israel and deliver Midian through the three hundred men.

before.question: Which judge tested God's will using a fleece of wool and defeated the Midianites with only three hundred men?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Judges 16:17 has Samson say he has been a Nazirite from his mother's womb, and 16:19 says Delilah had his seven braids shaved and his strength left him. Judges 16:31 says he judged Israel.

before.question: Which judge, a Nazirite from birth, lost his great strength after Delilah had his hair cut?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Judges 15:15-16 says Samson found a fresh donkey's jawbone and struck down a thousand men with it, so the answer is Samson, who judged Israel (Judges 15:20).

before.question: Which judge killed a thousand Philistines with the jawbone of a donkey?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Judges 3:15 calls Ehud son of Gera "a left-handed Benjamite," and Judges 3:21 says he reached with his left hand and plunged the hidden sword into Eglon's belly.

before.question: Which left-handed judge killed Eglon, the king of Moab, with a hidden sword?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Judges 11:30 names Jephthah as the one who made the vow, and 11:34-35 shows his daughter coming out to meet him and his grief over the vow.

before.question: Which judge made a rash vow to the Lord that led to great sorrow involving his own daughter?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Judges 3:9-10 says the LORD raised up Othniel son of Kenaz as a deliverer, and he became Israel's judge. Judges 2:16 mentions judges generally but names none, so Othniel is the first named.

before.question: Who was the first judge raised up by God after the death of Joshua?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Judges 3:31 says that after Ehud came Shamgar son of Anath, who struck down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad and saved Israel.

before.question: Which judge struck down six hundred Philistines with an oxgoad?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Habakkuk 1:1 identifies the book as the burden of Habakkuk the prophet, but no shown verse says where it sits in the canon. Its Old Testament placement is a fact about the Bible's order, not a verse.

before.question: Is the book of Habakkuk found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Judges 4:6 says Deborah summoned Barak son of Abinoam and told him to march to Mount Tabor with ten thousand men of Naphtali and Zebulun against Sisera.

before.question: Which military commander was called by Deborah to lead Israel's army against Sisera?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Joel 1:1 identifies Joel as the prophet who received the word of the LORD, but no shown verse classifies him as major or minor. The Major/Minor division comes from the book order and length of prophetic books in Bible editions.

before.question: Is Joel classified among the Major Prophets or the Minor Prophets?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: The shown verses never sort Jonah into Major or Minor Prophets. That division comes from the book's order and length in the Bible's arrangement, not from anything Scripture says.

before.question: Is Jonah classified among the Major Prophets or the Minor Prophets?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Zephaniah 1:1 shows only that the book records the word of the LORD given to Zephaniah in Josiah's days. No shown verse calls it Old Testament; that label comes from the Bible's division into Testaments.

before.question: In which part of the Bible is the book of Zephaniah found?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Isaiah 7:13 says "Then Isaiah said," and verse 14 gives the sign: the virgin will be with child and will name the son Immanuel.

before.question: Which prophet foretold that the virgin would be with child and give birth to a son called Immanuel?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: John 12:38 quotes Isaiah 53:1 ("Lord, who has believed our message?") as "the word of Isaiah the prophet," so the Servant passage is credited to Isaiah. Isaiah 53:5 itself names no author.

before.question: Which prophet wrote the "suffering servant" chapter describing one pierced for our transgressions?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Jeremiah 38:6 says the officials dropped Jeremiah into a cistern with only mud, and he sank into the mud. The "weeping prophet" nickname is tradition, though Jer 14:17 speaks of tears.

before.question: Which prophet, known as "the weeping prophet," was thrown into a muddy cistern for his message?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Haggai 1:1 shows Haggai as a prophet speaking in the reign of Darius, before the New Testament era. The shown verses do not name the Testament; its placement among the Old Testament books is a fact about the Bible's order.

before.question: Is the book of Haggai found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Jer 25:11-12 foretells seventy years of service to Babylon, and verse 13 says these are the words Jeremiah has prophesied. Daniel 9:2 also names Jeremiah for the seventy-year word.

before.question: Which prophet foretold that Judah's captivity in Babylon would last seventy years?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Ezekiel 37:1-14 records the prophet's vision of a valley full of dry bones that come together, receive flesh and breath, and live.

before.question: Which prophet saw a vision of a valley of dry bones coming to life?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Daniel answers the king's demand, saying God revealed the dream, and then says "now we will tell the king its interpretation," so Daniel gives the interpretation of the statue dream.

before.question: Which prophet interpreted King Nebuchadnezzar's dream of a great statue made of different metals?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Daniel says he will read the inscription for the king (5:17), then gives the reading MENE, MENE, TEKEL, PARSIN and its interpretation (5:25-28).

before.question: Which prophet read the handwriting on the wall for King Belshazzar?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: God tells Hosea to take a prostitute as his wife, and Hosea marries Gomer daughter of Diblaim, so the answer Hosea is stated in the reference.

before.question: Which prophet was told by God to marry an unfaithful woman as a picture of Israel's unfaithfulness?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Acts 2:16 says the words Peter quotes, "I will pour out My Spirit on all people," were "spoken by the prophet Joel," so the answer is Joel.

before.question: Which prophet's words about God pouring out His Spirit on all people were quoted by Peter at Pentecost?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Amos 1:1 names the speaker as Amos, one of the sheepherders of Tekoa. The social-injustice clue is not stated in this verse; it describes the book's content, which the shown passages do not cover.

before.question: Which prophet was a shepherd from Tekoa who preached strongly against social injustice?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Obadiah 1:1 names the author ("This is the vision of Obadiah") and gives the message about Edom. The claim that it is the shortest Old Testament book is not in the verses.

before.question: Which prophet wrote the shortest book in the Old Testament, a message of judgment against Edom?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: God tells Jonah to go to the great city of Nineveh and preach against it because its wickedness has come up before Him. The answer is stated directly.

before.question: Which prophet was sent to preach against the wicked city of Nineveh?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Micah 5:2 foretells a ruler coming out of Bethlehem Ephrathah, and Micah 1:1 says the word of the LORD came to Micah the Moreshite, so the prophet is Micah.

before.question: Which prophet foretold that the Messiah would be born in Bethlehem?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Nahum 1:1 opens with "This is the burden against Nineveh, the book of the vision of Nahum the Elkoshite," naming Nahum as the prophet.

before.question: Which prophet's book begins, "This is the burden against Nineveh"?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Habakkuk 2:4 contains the words "the righteous will live by faith," and the book is Habakkuk, so the answer is stated in the verse itself.

before.question: Which prophet wrote the words "the righteous will live by faith"?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Zephaniah 1:1 names Zephaniah as the one to whom the LORD's word came in the days of Josiah, and 1:14 announces that the great Day of the LORD is near.

before.question: Which prophet warned of a coming "Day of the LORD" of judgment during the reign of Josiah?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Haggai 1:1 names Haggai as the prophet, and verses 2 and 8 record his message that the people say the time has not come to rebuild, and his command to build the house.

before.question: Which prophet urged the returned exiles to stop delaying and rebuild the Temple?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Zechariah 9:9 foretells the king riding on a donkey, and Zechariah 11:12-13 the thirty pieces of silver. Zechariah 1:1 names the prophet Zechariah as the one receiving these words.
ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.doubt: Matthew 27:9 attributes the thirty-pieces prophecy to "Jeremiah the prophet," though the words it quotes are in Zechariah 11:12-13.

before.question: Which prophet foresaw the Messiah riding into Jerusalem on a donkey and being sold for thirty pieces of silver?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Malachi 1:1 names the prophet and calls the book the word of the LORD, but no shown verse says which testament it belongs to; that division concerns the Bible's arrangement.

before.question: Is the book of Malachi found in the Old Testament or the New Testament?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: In 2 Kings 2:9 Elisha asks for a double portion of Elijah's spirit, and in 2:14 he strikes the Jordan with Elijah's cloak and the waters part for him.

before.question: Which prophet asked for a double portion of his master Elijah's spirit and later parted the Jordan River?

ayandangubane-bible-quiz:scripture-buzze.note: Elisha, the man of God, cut a stick, threw it into the Jordan, and made the borrowed iron axe head float (2 Kings 6:5-7).
